records.product: ITU-R BS.1770-5 (public standard, not a product)
records.title: Recommendation ITU-R BS.1770-5 — Algorithms to measure audio programme loudness and true-peak audio level
sections_inspected: Scope, Keywords, and the 'recommends' clauses 1-5 (front matter, pages 1-2)

Annex 1 - Specification of the objective multichannel loudness measurement algorithm: complete normative text, including the four-stage summary, Table 1 (stage 1 pre-filter coefficients), Table 2 (stage 2 RLB weighting coefficients), equations (1)-(7), Table 3 (per-channel weighting coefficients), and the LKFS designation notes
Attachment 1 to Annex 1 (informative) - sections 1 Introduction through 4 Subjective tests read; sections 5 onward (multichannel algorithm development and results) not extracted

Annex 2 - Guidelines for accurate measurement of 'true-peak' level: complete normative text, including section 1 Summary, section 3 Detailed description, and the order-48 4-phase FIR interpolation coefficient table
Attachment 1 to Annex 2 (informative) - Considerations for accurate peak metering of digital audio signals: read in full, including the over-sampling-ratio versus maximum-under-read table
Annex 3 - Extended loudness measurement algorithm for advanced sound systems: read, including Table 4 (position-dependent weightings by azimuth/elevation) and Table 5 (per-configuration weightings)
Annex 4 - Loudness measurement algorithm for object-based audio: read in full (renders to a loudspeaker configuration, then applies Annex 1/Annex 3)
records.version_evidence: The PDF title page states 'Recommendation ITU-R BS.1770-5 (11/2023)' and the revision history line reads '(2006-2007-2011-2012-2015-2023)'. The revision number is carried in the document identifier and in the retrieval URL itself. The body was read from the official ITU PDF at https://www.itu.int/dms_pubrec/itu-r/rec/bs/R-REC-BS.1770-5-202311-I!!PDF-E.pdf, retrieved 2026-08-15 (1.9 MB, © ITU 2023), text-extracted locally with pdftotext -layout. Unlike the vendor documentation in this ledger, this source is versioned and dated by its publisher.
records.access_limitation: The document body WAS read for this record; the earlier inventory-only limitation no longer applies. Read: the normative text of Annex 1 and Annex 2 in full, including every coefficient table, equation, threshold, and unit designation; the informative Attachment 1 to Annex 2 in full; Annex 3's weighting tables; and Annex 4 in full. NOT read: Attachment 1 to Annex 4, and sections 5 onward of Attachment 1 to Annex 1 (both informative). Figures are raster images in the PDF and were NOT readable by the text-extraction path - Figure 1 (algorithm block diagram), Figures 2-4 (filter response curves and the 2nd-order filter signal-flow diagram), and the Annex 2 and Annex 3 block diagrams contribute no claim here. Where a figure carries the only statement of a fact, that fact is recorded as a gap rather than inferred. No verbatim reproduction of the standard's text is stored in this repository; the extracted text was held in a temporary working directory outside the repo and the recorded observations are paraphrase plus exact numerals.
records.notes: Recorded to separate the public loudness/true-peak standard from vendor behavior. GAP-OZONE-0001 notes that the inspected Ozone 12 pages never name BS.1770 at all - only 'BS.1771' as a meter scale name - so no Ozone record may be read as evidence about this standard, and this record may not be read as evidence about Ozone; that separation survives this upgrade unchanged. Claims extracted from this record live in docs/02-reference-research/loudness-standards-observations.md under the OBS-BS1770-* prefix. The companion EBU records SRC-EBU-R128, SRC-EBU-TECH3341, and SRC-EBU-TECH3342 were added to this ledger in the same pass and supply the delivery target, meter timing, and LRA definitions that this Recommendation deliberately does not state.

records.access_limitation: The document is short (5 pages of substance) and was read in full; there is no unread section. The URL is unversioned - https://tech.ebu.ch/docs/r/r128.pdf serves whatever revision is current, so a future fetch of the same URL may return a different document. The R 128 supplements s1 (short-form content), s2 (streaming), s3 (radio), and s4 (cinematic content) are cited by this document but were NOT retrieved; s2 is the one that would carry streaming-platform guidance, and its absence is recorded as a gap. records.notes: This is the record that supplies a delivery target value. R 128 states the target level, its tolerances, and the permitted maximum true-peak level for broadcast production, and defers the measurement algorithm entirely to ITU-R BS.1770 and the metering specification to EBU Tech 3341. It is a broadcast recommendation: it is NOT a streaming-platform target and must never be cited as one. EBU technical publications name their contributing experts rather than a single author; the drafting group is PLOUD under the EBU Technical Committee.
